edits.text: 第二条（关于国家示范城市指定的过渡措施）本法施行前由国土交通部长官指定的国家示范城市，不受原规定限制，视为依本法指定。

附则 <第16631号，2019年11月26日>

本法自公布之日起满三个月之日施行。但第三十五条之三的修订规定自公布之日起满六个月之日施行。

adjudications.reason: Korean: '이 법 시행 전에 국토교통부장관이 지정한 국가시범도시는 종전의 규정에도 불구하고 이 법에 따라 지정된 것으로 본다.' Existing candidate index 78 accurately captures deeming effect and avoids adding an unnecessary second occurrence of 国家示范城市. Other candidate from 79,84 is semantically equivalent but longer.

Korean supplementary provision no. 16631 explicitly states 3 months from promulgation, except amended Article 35-3 after 6 months. Both prior candidates are broadly consistent; use existing candidate from 79,84 to express elapsed months accurately and preserve '제35조의3' distinct from 35(3).
